name: Transfer Out Instruction V 10
definition: Scope|The TransferOutInstruction message is sent by an instructing party, for example, an investment manager or its authorised representative, to the executing party, for example, a transfer agent, to instruct the delivery of a financial instrument, free of payment, on a given date from a specified party.|This message may also be used to instruct the delivery of a financial instrument, free of payment, to another of the instructing parties own accounts or to a third party.|Usage|The TransferOutInstruction message is used to instruct the withdrawal of a financial instrument from one account and deliver it to either another account or to a third party.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Reference that uniquely identifies the message from a business application standpoint.

PoolReference.name: Pool Reference
PoolReference.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

PreviousReference.name: Previous Reference
PreviousReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously sent.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously received.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual transfers as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual transfers together.

TransferDetails.name: Transfer Details
TransferDetails.definition: General information related to the transfer of the financial instrument.

AccountDetails.name: Account Details
AccountDetails.definition: Information related to the account from which the financial instrument is to be withdrawn.

SettlementDetails.name: Settlement Details
SettlementDetails.definition: Information related to the receiving side of the transfer.

MarketPracticeVersion.name: Market Practice Version
MarketPracticeVersion.definition: Identifies the market practice to which the message conforms.

CopyDetails.name: Copy Details
CopyDetails.definition: Information provided when the message is a copy of a previous message.

Extension.name: Extension
Extension.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

RequestedSettlementDateRule.definition: Either TransferDetails/RequestedSettlementDate may be present in one or more occurrences of TransferDetails or SettlementDetails/RequestedSettlementDate may be present, but not both.
